grammar_focus: 定语从句(who/which/that,并列关系词 who…but who…)、被动语态各时态(have been reported / was noticed / was given)、现在分词短语作状语(moving…, wearing…)、be able to do + the moment 引导时间从句、疑问词引导的宾语从句(why…, how…, where…)(NCE4 无 KS 页,考点由课文结构自取;原创承载·一名视力正常却能用皮肤感知形状与颜色的少女受科学委员会测试的奇闻·题材科普无害;为 IP 洁净化用原创虚构人物与情节;美语化 color/gray;第四册第4课)
scene: 近些年,有人报道了几起怪事:某些人似乎能用指尖辨别颜色,甚至能感知藏在一堵实墙后面的物体。其中最不可思议的一例,说的是一个名叫娜迪亚的小姑娘——她视力完全正常,却还能透过手上的皮肤感知形状和颜色。她这份异能最早是被母亲注意到的。一天下午,娜迪亚把手放在一只小保险箱关着的门上,毫不迟疑地说出了锁在里面的硬币,还问为什么那儿存了那么多旧硬币。她这份天赋的消息很快传到一群科学家那里;春天,一个专门的委员会给她做了一长串测试。测试中,她能隔着一块不透明的屏读出印在纸上的字;更奇的是,她把胳膊肘在一叠彩色卡片上缓缓移动,竟一张张准确报出颜色。在另一项测试里,她戴着厚手套,用一根手指描出了藏在地毯下面那幅画的轮廓。科学家发现,她的膝盖和肩膀也有类似的敏感度。整个测试过程中娜迪亚都被蒙着眼;事实上,只要不蒙眼,她似乎就完全失去了这种能力。人们还发现:尽管她能用手指感知,可她的手一沾湿,这能力就立刻停止了。

grammar_card.title: 定语从句 / 被动各时态 / 现在分词作状语 / be able to do·the moment
grammar_card.intro: ①定语从句 who/which/that 修饰名词;并列时可 who…but who…。②被动语态各时态:have been reported(现在完成)/ was noticed(过去)/ was given(过去)。③现在分词短语作状语,表伴随/方式:Moving her elbow…, she named…。④be able to do=能够做;the moment=“一…就…”,引导时间从句。⑤疑问词 why/how/where 引导宾语从句,用陈述语序。

rows: have been / was + 过去分词
ceased the moment her hands were wet

specialRules.rule: 现在完成的被动=have/has + been + 过去分词:cases have been reported。
the moment / the instant 相当于 as soon as,引导时间从句,“一…就…”。
specialRules.mark: the moment her hands were wet

specialRules.rule: 美式拼写:color(颜色,英式 colour)、gray(灰色,英式 grey)。本课已按美语写。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — How did the girl discover she had this unusual gift?
options: Her mother noticed it when she laid her hand on a closed safe
She read about it in a newspaper
She saw it in a dream

passage: In recent years several strange cases have been reported of people who seem able to detect colors with their fingertips, or even to sense objects hidden behind a solid wall. One of the most remarkable concerns a young girl named Nadia, who has perfectly normal vision but who can also perceive shapes and colors through the skin of her hands. Her unusual gift was first noticed by her mother. One afternoon Nadia laid her hand on the closed door of a small safe and, without hesitation, described the coins locked inside and asked why so many old ones had been kept there. Word of her talent soon reached a group of scientists, and in the spring she was given a long series of tests by a special commission. During these tests she was able to read a page of print through an opaque screen; and, stranger still, moving her elbow slowly over a set of colored cards, she named each color correctly. In another test, wearing thick gloves, she traced with one finger the outline of a picture that had been hidden beneath a rug. The scientists found that her knees and shoulders showed a similar sensitivity. Throughout every trial Nadia was blindfolded; indeed, unless she was blindfolded she seemed to lose the power altogether. It was also discovered that, although she could perceive things with her fingers, the ability ceased the moment her hands were wet.

grammar_points.name: 被动语态各时态(have been / was + 过去分词)
现在分词短语作状语(moving / wearing)
be able to do + the moment 时间从句
疑问词引导的宾语从句(why/how/where)

stage5.stem: "The report concerns people ___ can detect colors with their fingers."(定语从句,指人,作主语)
stage5.stem_cn: 报告说的是能用手指辨色的人。

stage5.stem: "Nadia has normal vision but ___ can also perceive through her skin."(定语从句,并列关系词,指人)
stage5.stem_cn: 娜迪亚视力正常,却还能用皮肤感知。

stage5.stem: "She traced the outline of a picture ___ had been hidden under a rug."(定语从句,指物,作主语)
stage5.stem_cn: 她描出了藏在地毯下那幅画的轮廓。

stage5.stem: "Several strange cases ___ been reported in recent years."(现在完成的被动:___ + been + 过去分词,填助动词)
stage5.stem_cn: 近年来报道了几起怪事。

stage5.stem: "Her gift was first ___ by her mother."(一般过去被动:was + 过去分词,填过去分词)
stage5.stem_cn: 她的天赋最初是被母亲注意到的。

stage5.stem: "She was ___ a long series of tests by a commission."(一般过去被动:was + 过去分词“被给予”)
stage5.stem_cn: 一个委员会给她做了一长串测试。

stage5.stem: "___ her elbow over the cards, she named each color."(现在分词作状语,主动“移动…”)
stage5.stem_cn: 她把胳膊肘在卡片上移动,叫出每种颜色。

stage5.stem: "___ thick gloves, she traced the hidden outline."(现在分词作状语,“戴着…”)
stage5.stem_cn: 戴着厚手套,她描出了隐藏的轮廓。

stage5.stem: "She read the page, ___ her fingers lightly over it."(现在分词作伴随状语)
stage5.stem_cn: 她指尖轻拂纸面,读出了那一页。

stage5.stem: "During the tests she was ___ to read through an opaque screen."(be ___ to do:能够做某事,填这个形容词)
stage5.stem_cn: 测试中她能隔着不透明的屏读字。

stage5.stem: "The power ceased the ___ her hands got wet."(the ___=一…就…:引导时间从句,填名词)
stage5.stem_cn: 她的手一沾湿,那能力就消失了。

stage5.stem: "She was able ___ describe the coins inside the safe."(be able + 不定式:填不定式符号)
stage5.stem_cn: 她能描述保险箱里的硬币。

stage5.stem: "She asked ___ so many old coins had been kept there."(疑问词从句,填‘为什么’)
stage5.stem_cn: 她问为什么那里存了那么多旧硬币。

stage5.stem: "The scientists could not explain ___ she did it."(疑问词从句,填‘怎样’)
stage5.stem_cn: 科学家无法解释她是怎么做到的。

stage5.stem: "No one knew ___ her strange gift came from."(疑问词从句,填‘从哪里’)
stage5.stem_cn: 没人知道她这奇特天赋从何而来。

stage5.stem: "Not letting light through means ___."(“不透明的”用哪个词)
"To become aware of something through the senses is to ___ it."(“感知”用哪个词)
"To stop happening is to ___."(“停止”用哪个词)
